original.target_description: Experiment 1, main framing effect on willingness to pay for a real-payoff risky prospect: lottery ticket versus uncertain gift card, $10/$20 Best Buy gift-card outcomes. PDF p. 3 (printed p. 727), Results; independent-samples t test after the lowest-possible-outcome comprehension exclusion. The page also reports a separate risk-association pretest and comprehension chi-square; those tests were not selected.

n.sample_role: Participants retained for the main Experiment 1 WTP analysis, reported separately by condition.
n.exclusions: Only responses correctly identifying the $10 gift card as the lowest possible outcome were included. Initial recruitment was 119; retained condition counts are used rather than recruitment N.
n.location: PDF p. 3 / printed p. 727, Experiment 1, Results, first paragraph
